title: Campaigns
description: data/running/owner/campaigns.yaml: fundraising campaigns, each linked to a race. List files carry no schema_version; they are always the current version.

id.description: Slug, at most 30 characters (it forms a GitHub label).

race_id.description: An id in upcoming-races.yaml, or a slug under races/.

name.description: Must equal section.yaml focus_race.charity.name when race_id is the focus race (FR-024).

registered.description: The legal charity: name and number together.

number.description: The registered number, as a string, e.g. "256789".
number.x-error: is not a charity number (digits only, in quotes)

page_url.description: The JustGiving page: https://www.justgiving.com/page/<name>. A typing mistake that keeps this shape is caught by the first read (404, alert).
page_url.x-error: is not a JustGiving page address (expected https://www.justgiving.com/page/<name>, lowercase, no trailing slash)

target.x-error: is not set here: the target is read from the JustGiving page (FR-021)
